author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX has finally caught a Starship from orbit, with Ship 42 returning to Starbase less than a day after Flight 15. In this week’s Starship Update, we break down the booster diversion caused by low propellant during the boostback burn, the Raptor 3 performance issues and upcoming v3.2 upgrades, the ship catch dynamics including swaying and ablative material contact, and the valuable heat-shield data recovered from Ship 42 - including missing tiles, oxide streaks, and curved tile performance.

We also cover the latest production status of Booster 23, Ship 43, and subsequent vehicles, recent cryo testing and engine activity at McGregor, and progress toward the first Starship launches from LC-39A on the Space Coast.

title: Why Booster 22 Missed the Catch on Flight 15 | Starship Update
